description: Na₄UO₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one UO₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent UO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.65 Å. U⁶⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form UO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There are four shorter (2.02 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) U-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five equivalent Na¹⁺ and one U⁶⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅U octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent U⁶⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄U₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°.
